from datetime import datetime
import re
note_content = res['content']
# get today's weekday
now_dt = datetime.now()
weekday = now_dt.strftime('%A').lower()
print('now_dt:', now_dt, 'weekday:', weekday)
# find day section
# pattern like 'day: tuesday' then duration_mins: number
pattern = r"day:\s*" + re.escape(weekday) + r"\n(?:.*?\n)*?duration_mins:\s*(\d+)"
m = re.search(pattern, note_content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
print('matched:', bool(m))
if m:
    duration_mins = int(m.group(1))
    print('duration_mins:', duration_mins)
    needed_seconds = duration_mins*60
    print('needed_seconds:', needed_seconds)
else:
    # fallback: check all day entries
    days = re.findall(r"day:\s*([a-z]+).*?duration_mins:\s*(\d+)", note_content, flags=re.IGNORECASE|re.DOTALL)
    print('days found:', days)
